about: Reviews copied from the Toymak TikTok Shop, exactly as written there. They show on the shop-wide /reviews page. Listings just record which TikTok screenshot each batch came from. Import with: node scripts/import-tiktok-reviews.mjs (add --dry-run to check first). Re-running is safe: each review is saved under its id, so fixing a typo here and re-running updates it.

fields.name: as TikTok shows it (already masked, e.g. V**a)
fields.comment: review text, empty string for a star-only review
fields.fit: small | as_expected | large | null (from 'Fit:'; null when TikTok shows none)
